problem: Prior VLN work is scattered across methods, benchmarks and embodied-intelligence themes, and the difficulty of aligning visual information with language instructions and of generalizing to new environments lacks a systematic overview.
motivation: VLN is a key path toward embodied intelligence and spans AI, NLP, CV and robotics, with applications such as human-computer interaction. The complex chain from language understanding to action execution makes vision-language alignment and generalization hard, so a practical reference for researchers is needed. (Only the abstract was available, so this is drawn from it alone.)
